baseline.source: canon: WFB 8e Ogre Kingdoms army book (Tyrants rule tribes, Butchers serve the Great Maw, Gnoblars serve as servants, Bulls and Ironguts as the warrior host, Maneater mercenaries); TW:WH Ogre Kingdoms
baseline.why: Each tribe is ruled absolutely by its Tyrant with a warrior host and Butcher-priests, feeds on meat, keeps Gnoblar servants in bondage and roams freely; ogre gunpowder (Leadbelchers, Ironblasters) sits above the tribal floor at tier 6
